ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal lobes against 60% low-intensity dark-brown/black pixels in the central and medial trailing edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous white geometric zones occupy the outer halves of both lobes. The left lobe contains a roughly triangular white patch extending from the tip towards the center. The right lobe features an elongated white region along the outer margin. The central fluke area and the majority of the trailing edge consist of solid dark pigmentation with stippled/mottled transition boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible central V-shaped notch with a sharp vertex angle approximately between 30 and 45 degrees; depth is partially obscured by water turbulence at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edges; the left lobe shows high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (saw-tooth pattern), while the right lobe displays fewer, more rounded wave-like variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edges sweeping upwards to acute, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast yellowish-white textured clusters present at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating heavy barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Permanent irregular indentation/notch on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy biological encrustations (barnacles) localized at the lobe terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated dark pigment island (focal spot) located within the upper-medial portion of the white patch on the left lobe.
